introduce: Lie down on your side with your head rested on your left arm. Lift your upper leg up and return to the start position.\n\nMake sure your right leg goes straight up and down during the exercise. It\'s a great exercise for the gluteus.
name: SIDE-LYING LEG LIFT RIGHT

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Your leg should go straight up and down.
Keep your legs straight.
Your toes should point forward.
Don't rotate your leg forward or backward.
Exhale when lifting your leg, and inhale when lowering.
To get more of a challenge, add weight on your ankle.
Hold for a few seconds when lifting your leg.
This is a great exercise for your glutes and quadriceps.

introduce: Lie on your right side with head resting on your right hand. \n\nThen put your left foot forward on the floor. Lift your right leg up and down.
name: BOTTOM LEG LIFT RIGHT

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Tighten your core.
Keep your upper body still.
Exhale when lifting your leg, and inhale when lowering it.
If you feel it's too easy, lift your leg as high as you can.
It works if you feel your bottom inner thigh burning.
This exercise is good for your inner thighs.

introduce: Lie on your left side with your head resting on your left hand. \n\nThen put your right foot forward on the floor. Lift your left leg up and down.
name: BOTTOM LEG LIFT LEFT

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Tighten your core.
Keep your upper body still.
Exhale when lifting your leg, and inhale when lowering it.
If you feel it's too easy, lift your leg as high as you can.

introduce: Lie on your right side with your head resting on your right hand. \n\nThen lift your left leg and rotate your foot in circles.
name: SIDE LEG CIRCLES LEFT

tips.text: This workout should be done on a mat.
Make sure your body stays straight.
Your lifted leg should be directly over your body.
Breathe regularly.
To get more of a challenge, don't support yourself with your upper hand on the floor.
Your lower back should not feel sore.
This exercise works on your legs and lower abdominals.

introduce: Lie on your left side with your head resting on your left arm and knees bent. \n\nLift your right knee upwards while keeping your heels touching, then go back to the starting position. Repeat the exercise.
name: PILATES CLAMSHELL RIGHT

tips.text: Please do it on a mat.
Please keep your pelvis and torso stable during the exercise.
Engage your core to keep your lumbar spine neutral.
Exhale as you lift the top knee up, and inhale as you lower it.
This exercise strengthens your glutes and thighs.

name: PILATES CLAMSHELL LEFT

introduce:
Lie on your right side with your head resting on your right arm and legs extended. 

Lift and bend your left knee in front of you, then kick your leg back. Repeat the exercise.
name: SIDE LYING KICKBACK LEFT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your body still when kicking your leg back.
Exhale when kicking your leg, and inhale when bringing it back.
Please try to keep your toes facing downward.
You should feel your glutes engage.
Please keep your back straight.
This exercise works your glutes.

introduce: Lie on your left side with left leg extended out and right knee bent, resting on the mat. \n\nLift left leg above the mat. Engage the inner thigh to draw small circles with left leg.
name: INNER THIGH CIRCLES LEFT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your torso stable.
Please keep your left leg straight.
Please lift your leg higher for better results.
This exercise can well work your inner thigh.

introduce: Lie on your right side with right leg extended out and left knee bent, resting on the mat. \n\nLift right leg up above mat. Engage inner thigh to draw small circles with right leg.
